free_tier.stated: not free. Promotional first-year prices with a separate renewal price

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a domain name

retention.stated: a registration runs for its term and renews at the regular price shown on the TLD page

interface_detail: a web dashboard, an API for registered domains, and a public pricing endpoint (api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3/pricing/get) that answers without an API key
chaining: a cheaper first year than Cloudflare on .org, and a more expensive second year on .xyz

limits.value: the promo price applies to the first year only; the renewal is the regular price

confidence_note: the price index, the TLD pages and the public pricing API give registration, renewal and transfer separately, in USD with the ICANN fee included, and mark each sale price

evidence.proved: .com from USD 11.08, .net from USD 12.52, .org from USD 7.98, on the pricing index
.xyz USD 2.04 first-year sale, regular price USD 14.21
Porkbun prices are in USD, for non-premium one-year terms
the ICANN fee is inside every Porkbun price
